english: Today I'd like to try cramming two worlds into the same space.
chinese: 今天，我想试着把两个世界塞进同一个空间

english: Here's what I ended up with.
chinese: 这是我最终做出来的效果

english: One place, two overlapping worlds: one dried out, one drowned.
chinese: 同一个地方，叠着两个世界：一个干涸，一个被淹没

english: And I have one body in each of them.
chinese: 而我在两个世界里各有一个身体

english: When their rules of physics disagree…
chinese: 两个世界的物理规则打架的时候……

english: …space itself tears into what I'm calling a conflict field.
chinese: 空间本身会被撕出一片「冲突场」

english: Also, something not entirely friendly is watching.
chinese: 还有一些不太友善的东西在看着

english: But we'll get to that. Let's start from the beginning.
chinese: 不过这是后话，我们先从头开始

english: First, the rules.
chinese: 先说清楚规则

english: World A and world B occupy the exact same space.
chinese: 世界 A 和世界 B 占据同一块空间

english: They can't see or touch each other. Neither can interfere with the other.
chinese: 它们互相看不见、碰不到，谁也干涉不了谁

english: A wall in A simply doesn't exist as far as B is concerned.
chinese: A 里的一堵墙，对 B 来说根本不存在

english: The one exception is the player.
chinese: 唯一的例外是玩家

english: The player exists in both worlds at once.
chinese: 玩家同时存在于两个世界

english: So I gave them two bodies, each colliding only with its own world.
chinese: 所以我给了他两个身体，各自只和自己的世界碰撞

english: The same input drives both bodies.
chinese: 同一份输入，同时驱动两个身体

english: As long as the worlds agree, the bodies overlap perfectly.
chinese: 只要两个世界意见一致，两个身体就完全重合

english: But the moment A says 'there's a wall here' and B says 'no there isn't'…
chinese: 可一旦 A 说「这里有墙」，B 说「这里没有」……

english: …the two bodies come apart. That's a contradiction.
chinese: 两个身体就会分开——这就是矛盾

english: This whole video is about figuring out what to do with it.
chinese: 这期视频的全部内容，就是想办法处理这个矛盾

english: First we need to see something. I'm going with voxels.
chinese: 先得能看见东西。我打算用体素

english: The whole scene is a single 128×40×64 3D texture.
chinese: 整个场景是一张 128×40×64 的三维贴图

english: The key idea: every cell stores two numbers.
chinese: 关键在于：每个格子存两个数

english: One is its material in world A, the other its material in world B.
chinese: 一个是它在世界 A 里的材质，一个是在世界 B 里的

english: Two worlds, one texture.
chinese: 两个世界，共用一张贴图

english: All the rendering happens in one fragment shader.
chinese: 渲染全部在一个片元着色器里完成

english: Each pixel fires a ray that steps through the grid one cell at a time.
chinese: 每个像素发出一条光线，一格一格地穿过网格

english: The algorithm is called DDA: each step lands exactly on the next cell boundary.
chinese: 这个算法叫 DDA：每一步都恰好走到下一个格子的边界

english: Because each cell holds two numbers, one ray learns about both worlds at once.
chinese: 因为每格有两个数，同一条光线能同时知道两个世界的情况

english: In code it looks roughly like this.
chinese: 写成代码大概是这样

english: Compare the distance to the next boundary on each axis, and take the nearest.
chinese: 比较三个轴上到下一个边界的距离，走最近的那个

english: Then read both materials for that cell.
chinese: 然后读出这一格的两个材质

english: Let's run it.
chinese: 跑起来看看

english: Well, we can see blocks. That's the good news.
chinese: 呃，能看到方块了，这是好消息

english: The bad news is both worlds are mashed into one blob. You can't tell which is which.
chinese: 坏消息是两个世界糊成了一坨，完全分不清谁是谁

english: Add a palette per world, three-band cel shading, and ink outlines.
chinese: 加上各自的调色板、三段式的赛璐璐明暗，再描个边

english: Much prettier, but the problem remains: which wall belongs to which world?
chinese: 好看多了，但问题还在：到底哪面墙属于哪个世界？

english: The outlines aren't a post-process: when a ray hits a face, it checks the neighbouring cells.
chinese: 描边没有用后处理：光线打中一个面时，顺手查一下四周的格子

english: If the neighbour is solid too, the surface is flat. No line.
chinese: 旁边同样是实心，说明这里是平的，不画

english: If there's something diagonally above, it's a crease.
chinese: 斜上方有东西，说明这是个折角

english: If the neighbour is empty, we've reached the silhouette.
chinese: 旁边是空的，说明到了轮廓的边缘

english: As for telling the worlds apart: I have the player "attend" to one of them.
chinese: 至于分不清世界的问题：我让玩家「注视」其中一个世界

english: The attended world is drawn solid.
chinese: 被注视的世界画成实心

english: The other is left as glowing outlines and a little haze.
chinese: 另一个世界只留下发光的轮廓和一点点雾

english: A ray hitting a ghost surface doesn't stop. It picks up a little colour and keeps going.
chinese: 光线碰到幽灵表面不会停下，而是带上一点颜色继续前进

english: And if a cell is solid in both worlds, then it's just… solid.
chinese: 如果某个格子在两个世界里都是实心，那它就是真的实心

english: The implementation is plain front-to-back compositing.
chinese: 实现起来就是从前往后累加颜色

english: Opacity depends on which world the surface belongs to, and which one we're attending to.
chinese: 透明度取决于这个面属于哪个世界，以及我们正在注视谁

english: That's a lot clearer.
chinese: 这样就清楚多了

english: Warm colours: the dried-out world A.
chinese: 暖色的是干涸的世界 A

english: Tap a key to attend to the other side: the cold, drowned world B.
chinese: 按一下键，注视另一边：冷色的、被淹没的世界 B

english: Incidentally, each world has its own sun, so the shadows point different ways.
chinese: 顺便，两个世界各有一个太阳，所以影子的方向也不一样

english: Things in A cast no shadow in B, and vice versa.
chinese: A 的东西在 B 里没有影子，反过来也一样

english: And these residents belong to one world only, so they drift straight through the other world's walls.
chinese: 还有这些居民：它们只属于一个世界，会直接穿过另一个世界的墙

english: Now for the physics.
chinese: 接下来是物理

english: Two bodies, each moving and colliding in its own world.
chinese: 两个身体，各走各的，各撞各的世界

english: Let's just run it with nothing else.
chinese: 先什么都不管，直接跑

english: Walk up to a wall that only exists in A…
chinese: 走到 A 才有的这堵墙面前……

english: A's body is blocked. B's body just keeps going.
chinese: A 的身体被挡住了，B 的身体继续往前走

english: Great. I am now two people.
chinese: 好的，我现在是两个人了

english: And there's no way to put me back together.
chinese: 而且永远合不回去

english: So something has to pull the bodies back together.
chinese: 所以需要有东西把两个身体拉在一起

english: The simplest thing is a spring.
chinese: 最简单的就是一根弹簧

english: The further apart, the harder it pulls.
chinese: 分得越远，拉力越大

english: I made it stiffen as it stretches, so the bodies can never drift too far.
chinese: 我让它越拉越硬，这样两个身体永远不会离得太远

english: It's only a few lines of code.
chinese: 代码只有几行

english: The force acts on A, and the opposite force acts on B.
chinese: 力作用在 A 身上，反方向的力作用在 B 身上

english: Try again.
chinese: 再试一次

english: This time B does get pulled back, and then… bounces out again.
chinese: 这次 B 确实被拉回来了，然后……又弹出去了

english: The two worlds are using me as a slingshot.
chinese: 两个世界在拿我当弹弓玩

english: Here's the distance between the bodies over time.
chinese: 这是两个身体之间的距离随时间的变化

english: A spring only stores energy and hands it straight back.
chinese: 弹簧只会把能量存起来，再原样还回去

english: Add damping proportional to their relative velocity to burn that energy off.
chinese: 加一个和相对速度成正比的阻尼，把能量耗掉

english: That's better.
chinese: 现在好了

english: A hits the wall, B leans forward a little, and is held firmly.
chinese: A 撞墙，B 往前探出去一点，然后被稳稳拉住

english: I keep pushing forward, and B can't move either.
chinese: 我继续往前推，B 也走不动了

english: The world with the wall is reaching through the spring to restrain me in the other one.
chinese: 墙所在的世界，正通过弹簧干涉另一个世界里的我

english: Let go, and the bodies merge again, back to a stable state.
chinese: 一松手，两个身体合二为一，回到稳定态

english: The contradiction now has a number: the tension in the spring.
chinese: 矛盾现在有了一个可以量化的数值：弹簧的张力

english: I want to make it visible.
chinese: 我想让它看得见

english: So I added another, lower-resolution 3D texture and called it the conflict field.
chinese: 于是我又加了一张低分辨率的三维贴图，叫它冲突场

english: Each frame I splat some intensity between the bodies and onto whatever they're pushing against.
chinese: 每一帧，往两个身体之间、以及被顶住的那面墙上「泼」一点强度

english: The higher the tension, the more gets splatted.
chinese: 张力越大，泼得越多

english: On the physics side, two splats per frame, scaled by tension.
chinese: 物理这边，每帧根据张力往场里泼两次

english: In the shader, every step of the ray also samples the conflict field.
chinese: 着色器里，光线每走一格就顺便采样一次冲突场

english: For colour I picked an obnoxious complementary pair, drawn as moving interference bands.
chinese: 颜色我选了一对很刺眼的互补色，做成流动的干涉条纹

english: It is, after all, two worlds interfering.
chinese: 毕竟这确实是两个世界在互相干涉

english: That looks pretty good!
chinese: 效果不错！

english: …it just doesn't seem to stop.
chinese: ……就是好像停不下来

english: I forgot to make it decay. Everywhere I go turns permanently pink.
chinese: 我忘了让它衰减。走到哪，哪就永久变成了粉色

english: Multiplying by something less than one each frame fixes it.
chinese: 每帧乘上一个小于 1 的系数就行了

english: Now the field glows with the conflict and fades once I let go.
chinese: 现在冲突越强，场越亮；松手之后慢慢消散

english: I also added chromatic aberration and screen tearing, driven by the same tension.
chinese: 我还加了一点色差和画面撕裂，强度同样跟着张力走

english: Walls touched by the field get hatched, so you can tell at a glance what's causing the argument.
chinese: 被冲突场碰到的墙会染上斜纹，一眼就能看出是谁在闹矛盾

english: And that lightning between the bodies is the spring itself.
chinese: 两个身体之间那条闪电，就是弹簧本身

english: As it stands, one thin wall can stop me forever.
chinese: 到这里，薄薄一堵墙就能把我永远挡住

english: That's a bit dull. What if I'm going fast enough?
chinese: 这有点无聊。如果我跑得足够快呢？

english: Here's the rule: when the tension exceeds a threshold…
chinese: 规则是这样的：当张力超过一个阈值

english: …and the bodies are still separating at speed…
chinese: 而且两个身体还在高速分离

english: …the blocked body 'phases out': it temporarily leaves its own world.
chinese: 被挡住的那个身体就会「脱相」：暂时离开自己的世界

english: It stops colliding with its own walls and gets yanked across by the spring.
chinese: 它不再和自己的墙碰撞，被弹簧一把拽过去

english: Version one was blunt: over the threshold, switch collision off for 0.12 seconds.
chinese: 第一版非常直接：超过阈值，就把碰撞关掉 0.12 秒

english: Give the player a dash and try the thin wall.
chinese: 给玩家加一个冲刺，试试薄墙

english: Straight through!
chinese: 穿过去了！

english: The bodies re-merge on the far side: a new stable state.
chinese: 两个身体在墙的另一边重新合上：这是一个新的稳定态

english: What about a thicker wall?
chinese: 那厚一点的墙呢？

english: …Ah.
The 0.12 seconds ran out, collision came back, and A's body is still inside the wall.
chinese: 0.12 秒到了，碰撞恢复，而 A 的身体还在墙里面

english: It's entombed in stone, with B's body tethered outside.
chinese: 它卡死在石头里，B 的身体被弹簧拴在外面

english: So a timer won't do.
chinese: 所以不能用计时器

english: A phased body should stay phased until it has actually left solid matter.
chinese: 脱相的身体应该一直保持脱相，直到它真的离开了实心区域

english: While phased, it obeys the other world's geometry instead. It's a guest there, after all.
chinese: 脱相期间，它改为服从另一个世界的几何——毕竟它正借住在那边

english: Meanwhile the wall grips it like friction; only a strong enough pull can drag it through.
chinese: 而墙会像摩擦力一样死死咬住它，只有足够大的拉力才拖得动

english: If the pull fades before it's out, the wall spits it back the way it came.
chinese: 如果拉力不够了它还没出去，墙就把它原路吐回去

english: In code, it's a very small state machine.
chinese: 写成代码，是一个很小的状态机

english: Thin wall: through.
chinese: 薄墙：穿过

english: It works the other way too: this coral wall exists only in B.
chinese: 反过来也一样：这堵珊瑚墙只存在于 B

english: Thick wall: halfway in, then spat back out.
chinese: 厚墙：冲进去一半，被吐了回来

english: How thick a wall you can pass depends entirely on how far the dash can stretch the spring.
chinese: 能穿多厚，完全取决于冲刺能把弹簧拉多长

english: I didn't hard-code that. It just falls out of the spring.
chinese: 这不是我写死的规则，是从弹簧里自己长出来的

english: Which means we can build little puzzles.
chinese: 于是可以做一点小谜题

english: A's thick wall has a doorway, but in B the doorway is plugged with coral.
chinese: A 的厚墙上有一扇门，可门洞在 B 里被珊瑚堵死了

english: Walk through A's door while smashing through B's coral.
chinese: 走 A 的门，同时撞穿 B 的珊瑚

english: There was one more bug I really did not see coming.
chinese: 还有一个我完全没料到的 bug

english: Climbing stairs, I'd occasionally twitch and drop into the steps.
chinese: 上台阶的时候，我会时不时抽搐一下，掉进台阶里

english: The cause: stepping up lifts A's body one cell in an instant, yanking the spring taut.
chinese: 原因是迈上台阶那一瞬间，A 的身体抬高一格，弹簧被猛地拉长

english: Tension spikes past the threshold, and A "tunnels" through its own floor as if it were a wall.
chinese: 张力一下子超过阈值，A 就把自己脚下的地板当成墙「穿」了过去

english: Hence that second condition from earlier: the bodies must still be separating at speed.
chinese: 所以才有了刚才的第二个条件：两个身体必须还在高速分离

english: On stairs, B is catching up rather than pulling away, so it no longer misfires.
chinese: 上台阶时 B 是在追上来，而不是在远离，就不会误触发了

english: So far the worlds only differ in where their walls are.
chinese: 到目前为止，两个世界只是墙的位置不同

english: It's more interesting if their physics differ too.
chinese: 更有意思的是让它们的物理规则也不同

english: Take this sunken court: dry in A, flooded in B.
chinese: 比如这个下沉的庭院：在 A 里是干的，在 B 里灌满了水

english: A's body is pulled down by gravity; B's body is pushed up by buoyancy.
chinese: A 的身体受重力往下掉，B 的身体受浮力往上漂

english: The spring sits between them, pulled both ways.
chinese: 弹簧夹在中间，被上下拉扯

english: They settle somewhere neither of them is happy with.
chinese: 最后停在一个谁也不满意的位置

english: In code, each body only feels the forces of its own world.
chinese: 代码上，每个身体只按自己世界的规则受力

english: The only thing linking them is still that spring.
chinese: 它们之间唯一的联系，还是那根弹簧

english: Walking into the court.
chinese: 走进庭院

english: In A I'm on dry ground, and yet my body slowly lifts off.
chinese: 在 A 里我明明走在干地上，身体却慢慢飘了起来

english: The conflict field stays lit but steady: a state that's 'close enough' to balance.
chinese: 冲突场一直亮着，但很稳定：这是一个「接近平衡」的状态

english: In A there's a low wall too high to jump.
chinese: A 里有一道跳不过去的矮墙

english: But B's buoyancy can carry A's body right over it.
chinese: 但 B 的浮力可以把 A 的身体拎过去

english: Next, B has a reef ceiling that can't be swum over.
chinese: 接着 B 里有一片礁石顶棚，游不过去

english: Now A's weight helps out: hold dive, and it drags B's body to the bottom.
chinese: 这回轮到 A 的重量帮忙：按住下潜，把 B 的身体拽到水底

english: Walking in one world, swimming in the other, each dragging the other along.
chinese: 一个世界走路，一个世界游泳，互相拉扯着前进

english: Here's how it looks from B's side.
chinese: 从 B 这边看是这样的

english: The rings on the water, by the way, are just a few sines in the shader.
chinese: 顺带一提，水面上这些圈也只是着色器里的几个 sin

english: One last idea.
chinese: 最后一个想法

english: Right now contradictions are permanent: the wall is forever in A and never in B.
chinese: 现在的矛盾是永久的：墙永远在 A 里、永远不在 B 里

english: What if the worlds corrected themselves?
chinese: 如果世界自己会修正呢？

english: I track a 'stress' value for each voxel involved in a contradiction.
chinese: 我给每个闹矛盾的体素记一个「应力」

english: Keep pushing on a wall until the stress fills up, and that voxel gets written into the other world.
chinese: 一直顶着墙不放，应力满了，这格体素就被写进另一个世界

english: Both sides now have a wall. Contradiction gone.
chinese: 两边都有墙，矛盾消失

english: Conversely, if you phase through, the voxels you passed are erased outright.
chinese: 反过来，如果是脱相穿过去的，经过的体素就被直接抹掉

english: Neither side has a wall. Contradiction also gone.
chinese: 两边都没有墙，矛盾同样消失

english: Either way, the worlds converge towards agreeing with each other.
chinese: 不管哪种，世界都在朝「两边一致」的方向收敛

english: Lean on this membrane that only exists in B.
chinese: 顶住这层只存在于 B 的膜

english: The field gets brighter…
chinese: 冲突场越来越亮……

english: …and then it sets. These cells now belong to both worlds.
chinese: 然后它凝固了。这几格现在同时属于两个世界

english: Move over and dash through instead.
chinese: 换个地方，冲过去

english: This time it leaves a hole.
chinese: 这次留下了一个洞

english: Walk around enough and I'll eventually grind the two worlds into one.
chinese: 只要我走得够多，两个世界迟早会被我磨成同一个

english: There is one small problem, though.
chinese: 不过有个小问题

english: With every conflict and every correction, that thing in the sky opens a little wider.
chinese: 每一次冲突、每一次修正，天上那个东西就睁开一点

english: It doesn't belong to A. It doesn't belong to B.
chinese: 它不属于 A，也不属于 B

english: It lives in the gap between them, and I've been helpfully prying that gap open.
chinese: 它住在两个世界的缝隙里，而我一直在帮它把缝撑大

english: …I've decided not to fix that bug for now.
chinese: ……我决定先不修这个 bug

english: And that's everything so far.
chinese: 这就是目前的全部了

english: There's lots more to try: different gravity directions, different rates of time…
chinese: 还有很多可以做的：不同的重力方向、不同的时间流速……

english: Or a third world.
chinese: 或者第三个世界

english: The demo and source are in the project folder if you'd like to walk around yourself.
chinese: demo 和源码都在项目文件夹里，可以自己进去走走

english: Thanks for watching.
chinese: 感谢观看
